name: 距离感应字重
title: 距离感应字重
description: 可变字重的指针感应场：每个字母按与指针的距离在轻/重两档可变轴之间连续插值，线性、指数、高斯三种衰减曲线可选，还能随压力染色、放大、上浮；指针离开可交给一道横扫的待机波浪，容器 ref 能把作用域圈进指定区块；rAF 落定自睡，减动效下关闭波浪。
cardDescription: 字母字重随指针距离连续变重变轻，离开后交给波浪呼吸。
keywords: 字母字重随指针距离连续变重变轻

prompt:
Implement the "VariableProximity" component from zero: a line of variable-font text where every letter's weight (and any other variable axes) is interpolated continuously with the pointer's distance — letters near the cursor swell from a light resting state to a heavy near state with a chosen falloff curve, can tint, grow and rise on the way, and can hand over to a travelling idle wave when the pointer leaves. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages, videos, images, or off-the-shelf effect components; its one external asset is a variable-font stylesheet imported by the stylesheet (the exact default URL is part of the embedded source). ## Structure & rendering - One component in VariableProximity.jsx plus VariableProximity.css. React >= 18; no runtime dependencies. Forwarded ref; displayName set. - The stylesheet imports a Roboto Flex variable-font stylesheet (opsz 8–144, wght 100–1000) and sets the root's font-family to 'Roboto Flex', sans-serif; it also ships a visually-hidden `.sr-only` utility. Swap the import for any stylesheet that serves the same variable font. - Root is a `` (className prepended): display inline, optional fontSize (number → px, string passes through), style merges in, onClick and remaining props spread onto it. Inside, the label is split on spaces into word spans (`data-word`, inline-block, nowrap) separated by non-breaking spaces, and each word contains one inline-block span per letter, each pre-set to fontVariationSettings = fromFontVariationSettings, color = fromColor, transformOrigin '50% 80%', aria-hidden. A trailing `.sr-only` span repeats the label for screen readers; the root span is the accessible name holder. - Line wrapping: a measure pass temporarily sets the root's white-space to normal, hides any produced breaks and resets letters to the from-state, then records which words start a new line (top greater than the previous word's by more than 2px); those indices get a real `
` before them on the next render and the root switches to white-space: nowrap so lines are stable. The pass re-runs when the label, from-settings or fontSize change, when the parent resizes (ResizeObserver with a 1px threshold, raf-throttled) and after fonts load. ## Pointer field - Pointer position arrives from window mousemove and touchmove (first touch), with an active flag; leaving the document or releasing the touch deactivates. Scroll (capture) and resize re-schedule measurement; a raf-throttled loop runs only while something can change. - Each letter targets level = falloff(distance(pointer, letter centre), radius) where radius is in px: linear = 1 − d / radius; exponential = (1 − d / radius)²; gaussian = (exp(−2(d / radius)²) − e⁻²) / (1 − e⁻²). Beyond the radius every letter targets 0. - containerRef (optional): when its element is mounted, the whole field is gated to that element's rect — a pointer outside contributes nothing (the overshoot outside the rect is counted against the radius), so a heading only reacts while the cursor is genuinely over its section. - Levels chase their targets with ease = smoothing > 0 ? 1 − exp(−dt / (smoothing × 400)) : 1 (smoothing 0 snaps instantly) and snap once within 0.002; when every letter has settled the loop sleeps. - Writing: each letter's font-variation-settings is interpolated per axis from the parsed from/to strings — 'axis' from + (to − from) × level; at level 0 the exact from string is written. Writes are cached per letter and only reassigned when the string changes. - Tint: when fromColor or toColor is set, letter colour = color-mix(in oklab, restColor X%, nearColor) with X = (1 − level) × 100 (restColor = fromColor or currentColor, nearColor = toColor or currentColor) — letters slide from the resting colour to the near colour with pressure. Transform: when scale ≠ 1 or lift ≠ 0, letters translate up by lift × level (em) and scale by 1 + (scale − 1) × level around '50% 80%'. ## Idle wave - idleWave = true (and not under prefers-reduced-motion): after the pointer has been inactive for more than 500ms while the element is visible (IntersectionObserver), a wave takes over — per-letter value = 0.7 × ((1 + cos(phase)) / 2)^2.2 with phase = ((x + 0.6 × y) / span − time / 3.2) × 2π, anchors measured relative to the text's bounding box and re-measured on resize and font load, span = max(220, text width × 0.85). The wave blends in and out over ~600ms (waveMix) and combines with pointer pressure by taking the max, so approaching the text damps the wave smoothly instead of snapping. ## Reduced motion & cleanup - prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables the idle wave entirely; the pointer field itself (direct manipulation) still responds. - Unmount cancels the frame, disconnects the observers, and removes every window/document listener. Multiple instances are independent. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | label | string | "" | The text; split on spaces into words. | | fromFontVariationSettings | string | "'wght' 400, 'opsz' 9" | Resting variation settings (the far state). | | toFontVariationSettings | string | "'wght' 1000, 'opsz' 40" | Near-state variation settings the letters interpolate toward. | | containerRef | RefObject | - | Element whose bounds gate the pointer field. | | radius | number | 50 | Influence radius around the pointer, in px. | | falloff | "linear" \| "exponential" \| "gaussian" | "linear" | How strength decays with distance. | | smoothing | number | 0.2 | Tracking lag 0–1; 0 snaps, higher glides. | | fromColor | string | - | Resting letter colour; enables tinting together with toColor. | | toColor | string | - | Near-state letter colour. | | scale | number | 1 | Extra growth at full strength (1 = none). | | lift | number | 0 | Rise at full strength, in em. | | idleWave | boolean | false | Travelling wave while the pointer is away. | | fontSize | number \| string | - | Font size (number → px); inherits when unset. | | className | string | "" | Extra class names for the root span. | | onClick | function | - | Click handler passed through to the root. | | style | CSSProperties | - | Inline styles for the root span. | ## Delivery & validation - Deliver the complete content of VariableProximity.jsx and VariableProximity.css plus install steps and the usage example; no ellipses, no "fill in the core yourself" placeholders. - Validate: letters swell toward toFontVariationSettings as the pointer approaches and relax with the chosen falloff; the three falloff curves are visibly different; smoothing 0 snaps and higher values glide; from/to strings with several axes all interpolate; tinting mixes fromColor → toColor and scale/lift grow and rise the letters around their baselines; containerRef gates the field to its element; wrapping text finds its line starts and inserts breaks that survive resize; idleWave breathes through the text after 500ms idle, stops when the pointer returns and never runs under reduced motion; the loop sleeps when settled; unmount leaves no listeners, observers or frames; multiple instances are independent; the line renders without overflow at 375 / 768 / 1440 wide.
